payload.gap_claim: Scanned field (from adr-answer-authenticity's own comparison + the retro scan): HA companion apps, LangGraph thread_id resumes, gotoHuman meta-callbacks, PagerDuty/Opsgenie mobile ack - all deliver a notification and take a mobile ack, but they shed the HASH-BOUND, CHANNEL-STAMPED grant that this engine's audit trail requires; their ack is a correlation-id possession check (exactly ours) but it closes an opaque 'approval', not a state-bound bless recorded beside chat/console/board grants. Raw ntfy sheds the process entirely. v2 sheds the phone completely - offers are localhost-only. The unclosed spot: a from-away bless that lands as a first-class grant indistinguishable in the audit chain from a desk bless.
payload.why_now: The design is already owner-ruled and red-teamed (v1 i15/i16: adr-ntfy-actions, adr-answer-authenticity, adr-kofmqtq re-verified 2026-07-21) - no design risk remains, only realization; the v2 gate/grant machinery now records channel + adjudicator on every grant (i9-attestation), so a phone grant slots in with zero new grant-schema work; and TODAY proved the need concretely - the delegation workaround exists only because this lane does not.
payload.value_props: One-pager A - the owner. Need: bless a gate without being at the machine | outcome: the offer pushes to the phone and one tap returns a hash-bound, channel=phone grant within the 6h window; PASS: a simulated phone tap (correct topic + offer hash) produces a grant recorded channel=phone, adjudicated_by=owner, bound to the offer hash - by test; the LIVE from-away tap is the owner-physical demo (RAID). Need: a wrong or late tap never binds | outcome: a tap for a stale/resolved offer or a duplicate is idempotently ignored; PASS: by test, a stale-hash tap and a double tap both leave the grant chain unchanged. One-pager B - the driving agent. Need: publish an offer outbound without wiring a live public endpoint unattended | outcome: the push is a pure function of {topic, brief} to an injectable transport (real ntfy in prod, mock in test); PASS: the publish is unit-tested against a mock transport, and no live topic is contacted during the build. Need: the credential stays the owner's | outcome: the topic/token reads from owner-provided config, never minted or logged by the agent; PASS: by test, a missing config disables the lane gracefully (no crash, board still works), and no secret appears in any log.
payload.business_case: Skipped, reason recorded: no acquirer; the currency is the owner's adjudication reach, already valued by today's delegation workaround standing in for it.
